name: Case 1 · Snatch
blurb: Market Mile, dusk. A bridge engineer is dragged off a bike taxi into a van.

beats.narration: Neon bleeding into gutter water. The scent of overripe plantain. You used to walk this beat.

beats.text: I grew up two streets over. When the Kites started snatching kids off bike taxis, everybody looked to the police. The police looked away.
My cousin Nkem was thirteen. Her case is still open. They call it cold. I call it waiting.
Induction day. You put in for INTERCEPT. The unit that catches them before the trail freezes.
Rookie. Callsign: Rook. You wanted the fast lane? You're in it. Try not to end up in a body bag before lunch.
Put the earpiece in. This is Sightline. It reads the city's pulse and predicts their escape routes. Trust the math, rookie.
[RADIO STATIC] Rook! Snatch in progress. Market Mile. Red van, three masked. We are Oscar Mike. Move!

lines.text: Tires scream over wet pavement. The van cuts off a bike taxi, hauling a woman inside. Doors slam. Engine gunned.
"I've got the wheel, you're on the ground. Hit the alley. FLUSH THEM OUT!"

scenes.win_text: The runner eats pavement over a crate of oranges. His delivery cart is dumped two stalls back. Time to tear it apart.

scenes.title: Where is the van going?
scenes.sentence: Sightline confirms: The van is heading to ___.

scenes.win_text: Chassis groans. You wrench the back doors open. Empty. They switched the hostage to a bike mid-chase. Ghosted.

scenes.prompt: Kemi Hart is shoving a phone in your face. 12.4k viewers live.

left.label: Give her an exclusive
left.result: She cuts the live feed. "Off the record? I owe you one, Rook."
left.echo: Kemi is an ally. The city stays calmer, and her tips open doors in Case 2.

right.label: Seize the phone
right.result: She uploads from a backup device before you even reach the cruiser. You just made an enemy.
right.echo: Kemi is a rival. She will reach your next crime scene before you do.

hesitate.label: You hesitated
hesitate.result: Dash body-blocks her and snatches the phone. He shoots you a glare. "Don't freeze on me."
hesitate.echo: Hesitation is its own answer, and the squad noticed.

scenes.title: You lost the victim
scenes.text: Commander Ife: "First day on the job, and you lost her." Ada Voss taps the glass monitor: "You didn't lose her, Rook. You were just blind. Tomorrow, you learn to use Sightline."
scenes.cliff: In holding, the runner you caught grins through bruised lips. "You didn't lose her, cop. You were shown exactly where to look."
